summary: Iteration 14 — Loyalty program, seasonal themes, and internal live chat. Backend regression: 5/5 pytest green (/api/loyalty/config public, /api/loyalty/me new user 0 pts Bronze tier, /api/loyalty/redeem insufficient balance 400, chat public start→message→admin list→admin reply→user sees reply, /api/settings PUT theme_mode+theme_manual roundtrip). Frontend: (a) Public /fidelite as guest → loyalty-cta visible, loyalty-rewards lists 3 rewards, all 3 reward-redeem-r{1,2,3} show 'Connectez-vous'; Bronze/Argent/Or tiers rendered. (b) After registering a fresh client account via tab-register (reg-firstname/lastname/email/password + auth-submit) — /fidelite shows loyalty-summary with loyalty-points=0 and loyalty-tier='Statut Bronze'; the 3 reward buttons are DISABLED with label 'Points insuffisants'. (c) /compte → tab-loyalty click → loyalty-panel renders with loyalty-summary inside. (d) Chat widget: chat-open-btn floating bottom-right on public pages; opens chat-window; while logged in, no start form needed; typed and sent 'Bonjour, question test iter14' via chat-input+chat-send-btn, message appears right-aligned in chat-messages. (e) Admin login → admin-tab-loyalty → admin-loyalty-panel with loyalty-rate, reward-add, tier-name-0, tier-min-0, loyalty-save all present; saving triggers 'Paramètres enregistrés' success toast. (f) admin-tab-chat → admin-chat-panel with chat-conv-list containing 4 conversations (test conv included); reply sent via chat-admin-input + chat-admin-send. chat-unread-badge is present when unread messages exist. (g) Seasonal theme: /admin → admin-tab-settings → 'Thème saisonnier' section with theme-mode + theme-manual selects. Switching mode=manual + theme_manual=autumn + settings-save → home '/' loads with document.documentElement.className='theme-autumn' and hero primary button becomes ORANGE rgb(234,88,12). Reverting mode=auto → className='theme-summer' and hero button turns CYAN/turquoise rgb(8,145,178) (server month = août 2026 → été). All 3 features work end-to-end.
critical_code_review_comments: Admin.jsx now approaches ~1100+ lines with LoyaltyAdminPanel + ChatAdminPanel + SettingsPanel embedded — consider extracting them to separate files (non-blocking, already noted in iter13).
ChatWidget polls every 4s regardless of visibility — consider pausing polling when tab is hidden (document.hidden) to save API calls (non-blocking).
SettingsContext applies the theme class on <html> reactively — verified working. Good separation via CSS variables and Tailwind palette.
Loyalty redeem endpoint currently returns 400 on insufficient points — UI correctly disables the button before allowing the request, so 400 path is defensive-only. Good.
